description: 调用链正负样本第一版：demo 样例 + libuv v1.50.0 真实产物。 扩充了64条待人工复核的缺失目标候选，自动标签不计入人工 Gold。

label_policy.positive: source/target/kind 与图中真实边一致
label_policy.negative: source/target/kind 与图中真实边不一致

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: loop_run(&loop);

samples.notes: app_main 直接调用 loop_run

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: int events = wait_for_events(loop, 100);

samples.notes: 事件循环主循环直接等待事件

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: run_ready_watchers(loop, events);

samples.notes: 事件返回后进入 watcher 分发

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: dispatch_once(loop, watcher, events);

samples.notes: watcher 就绪后直接调用分发函数

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: CALL_WATCHER(watcher, events);

samples.notes: CALL_WATCHER 宏通过结构体字段触发回调，候选目标不唯一

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: loop_register(&loop, 0, on_readable);

samples.notes: 注册点证明 on_readable 是候选，但不应声称这是唯一目标

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__io_poll(loop, timeout);

samples.notes: uv_run 的事件轮询入口

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__run_timers(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 的定时器阶段

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv_timer_again(handle);

samples.notes: 重复定时器的重新挂载

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: w->cb(loop, w, ev->fflags); /* XXX always uv__fs_event() */

samples.notes: 回调字段 w->cb 的目标集合需要结合赋值流继续收敛

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: CALL_WATCHER(watcher, events);

samples.notes: 真实关系是经过 Watcher::callback 的 callback_edge，不是 direct_call

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: loop_register(&loop, 2, on_once);

samples.notes: loop_run 只负责事件循环，不直接调用 on_once

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__queue_remove(queue_node);

samples.notes: uv_run 只能经 uv__run_timers 间接到达 uv__queue_remove

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv_timer_again(handle);

samples.notes: uv__run_timers 不直接调用 uv__io_poll

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__io_poll(loop, timeout);

samples.notes: source/target 存在，但正确 kind 是 direct_call，不是 callback_edge

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: loop_register(&loop, 2, on_once);

samples.notes: 真实注册关系通过 callback_edge 表达，不是 direct_call

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: r = uv__loop_alive(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 在循环开始前检查 loop 是否还活着

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__update_time(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 在循环开头更新时间

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__run_pending(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 执行 pending 阶段

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__run_idle(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 执行 idle 阶段

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__run_prepare(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 执行 prepare 阶段

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: timeout = uv__backend_timeout(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 计算 backend timeout

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__run_check(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 执行 check 阶段

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__run_closing_handles(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 执行 closing handles 阶段

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__queue_empty(&loop->pending_queue) &&

samples.notes: uv_run 判断 pending queue 是否为空

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__update_time(loop);

samples.notes: uv__io_poll 在进入 poll 前更新时间

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: uv__queue_remove(q);

samples.notes: uv__io_poll 从 watcher queue 移除已注册项

samples.label: positive

evidence.snippet: q = uv__queue_head(&loop->watcher_queue);

samples.notes: uv__io_poll 读取 watcher queue 头部

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__run_timers(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 到 uv__run_timers 是 direct_call；source/target 相同但 kind 错误，仍为 negative

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__io_poll(loop, timeout);

samples.notes: uv_run 到 uv__io_poll 是直接调用，不是 indirect_call

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__run_prepare(loop);

samples.notes: uv_run 到 uv__run_prepare 是直接调用，不是 callback_edge

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__io_poll(loop, timeout);

samples.notes: uv_run 不直接调用后续 poll 内部的 kqueue 删除逻辑

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__run_check(loop);

samples.notes: uv__run_check 是 uv_run 的阶段调用，不是 uv__io_poll 的直接调用

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__run_pending(loop);

samples.notes: uv__run_pending 是 uv_run 的阶段调用，不是 uv__io_poll 的直接调用

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__update_time(loop);

samples.notes: 方向错误：真实关系是 uv_run -> uv__update_time

samples.label: negative

evidence.snippet: uv__run_timers(loop);

samples.notes: 两者是 uv_run 的不同阶段，不存在 uv__run_timers -> uv__update_time 的直接调用
